## Summary

Four defects in `src/bos/infrastructure/http/http_client.ts` plus one in `src/bos/infrastructure/search/multi_source_search.ts`:

### 1. Body read has neither timeout nor cancellation after headers arrive (http_client.ts:284-290)

```ts
clearTimeout(timer);
if (signal) signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
const ab = await fetchRes.arrayBuffer();
```
Both the per-request timeout and the external abort listener are removed **before** reading the body. A server that stalls mid-body hangs the read (bounded only by undici's ~5-min default bodyTimeout), and an external AbortSignal (worker cancel of a large paper download) can no longer cancel the in-flight body read — it continues to completion.

**Fix:** keep `onAbort` attached through the body read; race `arrayBuffer()` against a body-timeout promise.

### 2. Retry logic is dead for timeouts and status-based retries (http_client.ts:172-187, 236, 304-306)

- The self-timeout at line 236 (`setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), timeoutMs)`) produces the fetch rejection message `"this operation was aborted"` (verified in Node). `isRetryableError` (178-187) checks `timeout|timed out` first (false), then `includes('abort')` → **returns false**. Timeouts are never retried despite `maxRetries`.
- Line 304-306 throws `new Error('HTTP 429')` for retryable statuses (RETRYABLE_STATUS: 408/429/500/502/503/504); that message matches none of `isRetryableError`'s patterns → **status-based retry never fires either**.

**Fix:** tag retryability on the error object (`Object.assign(new Error('HTTP 429'), { retryable: true })`), and in the catch distinguish self-timeout (`ctrl.signal.aborted && !signal?.aborted`) from external abort.

### 3. Cookie jar dead in default 'auto' mode; 'manual' contract broken (http_client.ts:243-283)

Cookies are only built/sent and merged/collected when `!doRedirect`, but `doRedirect` is true for the default `'auto'` → in the documented default path cookies are never sent, never collected, and an empty jar is saved. Conversely with `redirect:false`/`'manual'`, the 3xx branches end in an unconditional `continue` (279/282) so "manual" still follows the whole redirect chain (the comment claims otherwise). Latent today (only the downloader passes `'manual'`, where cookies happen to work; no caller passes `cookieJarPath`), but the documented API is broken both ways.

**Fix:** decouple cookie handling from `doRedirect`; honor `false`/`'manual'` by returning the 3xx response.

### 4. multi_source_search: no timeouts on any search fetch (multi_source_search.ts:90, 166, 220, 278, 306)

All five sources use raw `fetch()` with no AbortSignal/timeout, and `CachedSearchService` adds no wrapper. A hung source (Semantic Scholar is notorious) blocks `triz_search`; `target:"all"` waits for every source, bounded only by undici defaults (~5 min each).

**Fix:** route through `httpRequest` or pass `AbortSignal.timeout(15_000)` per source.
title: http_client: body read has no timeout/cancellation, retry logic is dead for timeouts and 429/5xx, cookie jar dead in auto mode; multi_source_search has no timeouts
